messages:
sara: Putting up a docs PR for a 'split-signing proxy' pattern for private/on-prem installs. Purpose: keep HSM in secure subnet, expose a tiny proxy in a semi-trusted zone for signing requests. Draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4412

leo: Can we include a simple network diagram and explicit CIDR examples? Also a short terraform SG snippet would help customers.

mina: Add a clear threat-model section: proxy must not persist keys; all crypto ops in HSM. Recommend audit headers: x-trace-id, user-id.

chris: For installer UX, add a preflight check (nc + curl) and a sample curl healthcheck. Example: 
```
nc -z proxy.example.com 8443 || echo "proxy unreachable"
curl --cacert proxy-ca.pem https://proxy.example.com:8443/v1/health
```

sara: Good. I'll include Node + Python SDK snippets for signing and mark them "example only". Also a systemd unit fragment and /v1/hsm endpoint that returns proxied HSM status.

mina: Security note: show token rotation flow (short TTL, refresh via client cert). Recommend encrypting tokens in the airgap bundle using KMS.

leo: Troubleshooting: call out common failures (tls handshake, token expired, hsm timeout) and a small table mapping errors to fixes. Also note CLI limit on CA size (if applicable).

chris: I'll open a tiny issue for a CLI CA-size quirk I hit and link it in PR.

ci-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4412  reviewers: @leo @mina @chris

sara: Thanks  I'll wait for the bug link and a security pass before merging.
